entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a new cycling jersey, and I was so excited, but it's just not right.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. I can definitely look into that for you. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just so incredibly tight, I can barely breathe in it. I feel terrible, I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this. I was hoping I could maybe exchange it.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let's see what we can do. Do you happen to have your order number?
Yes, it's... one second... it's VF8675309. To be honest, with the holidays coming up, I could really use the money back more than an exchange. I hope that's okay.
Thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order... VF8675309. Okay, I see it here. It looks like the jersey was delivered to you 31 days ago.
Oh no... is that too long? I've just been so busy. I'm so sorry.
Not at all! You're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process a full refund for you, no problem at all.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so, so much, David. You have no idea what a help that is.

You are very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you again. I really appreciate your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been great. Have a good day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
